globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: a tailored chocolate-brown two-piece business suit and a light-blue formal shirt with an open collar, no tie (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a seamless, plain, very light ivory off-white studio backdrop (almost white, with only a faint warm tint), brightly and evenly lit from edge to edge with no falloff, no vignette, no shadows, no texture and no objects - nothing else in the frame; identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: He faces the camera squarely for the whole clip: head, shoulders and body stay square to the lens, he never turns to the left or right and never points or presents to the side. Animated, energetic open-palm gestures in front of his chest, counting points on his fingers, small confident nods and a bright smile on emphasis; relaxed fingers close together; hands stay in front of his body, inside the frame and never in front of his face; he stays standing in the same spot, at the same distance from the camera, throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, crisp, clear and high-energy, fast continuous speech at a quick trainer's pace, NO background music, NO sound effects, NO silence at the start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: He stays in the same spot with his face and upper body fully visible at all times; NO turning the head or body to the side, NO looking away from the camera, NO pointing or presenting to the left or right, NO arm stretched out to the side, NO arms, elbows, hands or shoulders touching or cut by the frame edges, NO oversized hands, NO hands held toward the camera, NO big or spread-out fingers, NO thin or lanky body, NO wide-angle lens distortion, NO furniture, NO bookshelves, NO plants, NO lamps, NO props, NO objects behind him, NO icons or graphics, NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, NO other people
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, vertical. A medium-wide shot: he is STANDING in the middle of the frame, framed from mid-thigh up and fairly small in the frame, so his body fills only about the middle half of the frame width with wide empty backdrop on BOTH sides of him; his shoulders, elbows and hands always stay well inside the frame; clear space above his head. Eye level, natural portrait-lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session against a plain ivory backdrop, NOT a furnished room. Soft, bright, even high-key light: a soft frontal key light on his face with soft fill, no harsh shadows, natural skin texture, natural eye contact straight into the lens and PERFECT LIP SYNC: his lips, jaw and mouth shapes match every syllable of the dialogue exactly, in time with the voice, no mouth movement without sound and no sound without mouth movement, identical exposure and white balance in every scene. TRUE-TO-LIFE BODY: natural adult proportions that match his face - broad shoulders, a solid average build that fills the jacket (not slim, not lanky), and SLENDER, NATURAL-SIZE HANDS: each hand no longer than his face, relaxed fingers held close together, never spread wide, hands never closer to the camera than his chest
globalStyle.delivery: FAST, HIGH-ENERGY delivery, like a top law educator on YouTube coaching advocates straight to camera: quick, punchy pace (about 160 words per minute) with no slow stretches, a strong confident voice, rising energy, crisp emphasis on key words, bright smile, lively eyes; CRISP, PRECISE DICTION: every word pronounced fully, clearly and correctly in neutral Indian English, every consonant clear, the letters of an acronym spoken one by one (B N S S); only a very brief breath at each full stop; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word, never add words

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Charge sheet filed? That does not mean a full trial. The court must first screen the case, and that screening is where a sharp advocate can win early.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Under the B N S S, two tools do this screening: discharge and framing of charge. Know the court, section and deadline, and you can spare your client an unnecessary trial.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Discharge needs judicial consideration and recorded reasons. A denial alone will not get it, and neither will simply filing an application.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: The Judge considers the record and documents, and hears both sides. No sufficient ground for proceeding? The Judge must discharge the accused, and record reasons.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: In a different case, a Magistrate's warrant case on a police report, copies are supplied on the tenth of June. That starts its own application window.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Sections Two Thirty Four and Two Thirty Five cover its contents: the offence, the law, the time, the place, and the person involved. Check every particular.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Under Sections Two Fifty One and Two Sixty Three, the charge is read and explained, and the accused is asked whether he pleads guilty or claims trial.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Here is the line: strong suspicion founded on the material can justify framing a charge. Proof beyond reasonable doubt belongs to the decision on guilt.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Equally, a bare accusation without the required legal ingredients is not enough. So test the material against every ingredient.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: First file: the prosecution papers, even accepted at face value, contain nothing connecting Arjun to the theft. Argue that the charge is groundless, and seek discharge.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Second file: a witness account and supporting material link him to it. Then a dispute about the witness's reliability may need evidence at trial.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: One more trap: these sixty day clocks do not fit every case. Warrant cases not started on a police report follow Sections Two Sixty Seven to Two Sixty Nine.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: In summons cases, Section Two Seventy Four generally needs no formal charge. The particulars of the accusation are simply stated to the accused.

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing in the middle of the frame against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, wide empty space on both sides of him, facing the camera squarely and speaking fast and energetically straight to camera with perfectly lip-synced speech, hands in front of his chest, same position, size, outfit and framing in every clip, no text.
scenes.dialogue: But if the accusation is groundless, the Magistrate must record reasons and release the accused. That release then has the effect of a discharge.
